lines: With the voice that overflowed from my heart
I sing a melody — the future turned around
And the voice that overflowed from you
Merged with mine and rang out beneath the ultramarine sky
It's not a dream, it's not a dream — footprints of tears
It's no lie, it's no lie — smiles caked in mud
It's not a dream, it's not a dream — arms around each other, I want to shout
Let our longing reach you!
It doesn't have to be a miracle, it doesn't have to be beautiful
Because that thing called a reason to live shines so bright
A battery that never dies, with all our soul
We just burn up this thing called destiny and break loose
Earphones that stayed silent
A future drifting away from me because of my own weakness
Lyrics like "you'll be fine" or "hang in there"
There were nights they just made me angry
It's not a dream, it's not a dream — the frustration of that day
I won't forget, I won't forget — the claw marks in my palm
It's not wasted, it's not wasted — I want to honor all of that too
We're almost there now
Drenched in sweat from the heat of what we wish for
Carrying expectations as we stand, we grow timid under the weight
But the numbers on our backs aren't really there — the answer lies deep in our eyes
Overlapping, lighting each other up, forever
From the nerves, anxiety starts to sprout
And like roots taking hold, it comes to rule over us
But no way am I losing to something like that
Now I burn up this thing called destiny and break loose
Let it reach you!
It doesn't have to be a miracle, it doesn't have to be beautiful
Because that thing called a reason to live shines so bright
A battery that never dies, with all our soul
We just burn up this thing called destiny and break loose
We just hold this thing called destiny high and face it head-on
